title: A pending member sees their organizations and tenant ids
description:
## Found on `chatticus-b88c0a`

After `POST /organizations` the signed-in owner lands on the welcome screen that only says the organization is pending enablement. It does not list organizations, names, or `tenant_id`. The owner cannot copy `OrganizationId` for the published CloudFormation template, and cannot tell whether create succeeded.

`GET /me` already returns `organizations[].tenant_id` and `status`, but not `name`. The welcome view (`web/lib/membership-view.ts`) never renders that list.

## Done when

A pending (and enabled) member sees each of their organizations by **name**, **status**, and **tenant_id** without the members CLI. Behavior in Gherkin first.
